name: 放映游乐场
prompt:
Create one extremely polished high fidelity DESKTOP APPLICATION UI design image for MovieAgent, a personal Windows desktop short-drama filmmaking studio. This is an active user's real project workspace, not a public marketing landing page. Chinese UI. Full desktop screen front-on, all edges visible, landscape approximately 1568x1003. Display only the designed application screen, no monitor, no browser chrome, no outer presentation title or mockup labels. Sharp, readable Chinese labels, excellent typography and whitespace, premium contemporary creative-consumer tool, fresh and youthful for adults 20-35. Use the attached ACTUAL screenshot of xiaoyunque.com for the principles of content-led impact, capsule switches and immediate creative entry; transform it into MovieAgent's own original design. Do not copy Xiaoyunque brand, bird mascot, purple palette, promotional banner, currency or promises.

HARD COLOR RULE: large page backgrounds must be mathematically neutral pure WHITE #FFFFFF or cool neutral GRAY #F4F4F6, dark content stage #151517 permitted. Absolutely NO beige, yellow/tan, cream/ivory, sepia, warm paper, yellow-tinted shadows anywhere in UI surfaces. Saturated color belongs only to accents and media. No purple/blue gradients, holographic orb, AI sparkle icon, stock robot, emoji icons, generic glass panels, neon outlines or repeated dashboard statistic cards. No giant serif slogan. Use modern rounded grotesk Chinese sans serif with precise spacing and playful confident scale changes.

Shared realistic information: app MovieAgent; fictional project 周末出逃; current EP03 出发前夜; canvas 主画布. Youth road-trip short drama, generated artwork featuring friends in a sunlit modern coastal city, a teal scooter, red vending machine, saturated blue sky; tasteful cinema photography plus one stylized animated alternate project. Show Project→Episode→Canvas context. Main navigation groups 项目 / 创作 / 制作 / 素材 / 成片, and visible 任务 2 and 设置. Project is shared scope for characters/assets. Main continuation action 继续制作, correct specific target EP03 · 镜头07; optional 新建短剧. Supporting authentic counts: 18个镜头, 6待审核, 2进行中. No arbitrary global percent and no XP/coins/ranks/game rewards. Global key fields must never appear. Do not imply automatic full-film production or auto adopted Agent proposals. Functional secondary destinations should cover 分集, 画布, 创作Agent, 剧本分镜, 角色场景, 资产, 剪辑成片 via concise contextual navigation. Illustrative data only. Fit all content in one image with clear visual hierarchy.

DIRECTION A — PLAYFUL SCREENING LOUNGE. White shell, editorial black headings with vivid CORAL RED #FF5149 accents. Strongly redesign the entire page as a tactile, youthful screening lounge. Thin compact top bar, MovieAgent wordmark left and small circular embossed play-mark; centered compact capsule nav, tasks/settings right. White background surrounding a single deep-neutral-black panoramic project stage. The stage occupies the middle 40% of screen and uses a shallow curved perspective row of FOUR genuinely different project cover posters; current project 周末出逃 is larger, brightly lit and straight at center, neighbors are subtly tilted away. NOT a repetitive flat card grid. Tiny left/right controls, active project title and 继续制作 on the stage bottom without covering faces. Colored posters supply all rich color. Add one small ORIGINAL tactile 3D coral film-clapper sculpture peeking at upper right of this stage, no eyes, no arms, no character copied from any brand. Toy-like moulded ABS and precise contact shadow, one accent asset only.

Above stage left write compact large 继续你的故事 (approx 34px), next to short current context 周末出逃 / EP03 出发前夜 / 主画布, new project button aligned right. Below stage, a flat horizontal episode filmstrip on white with EP01 / EP02 / EP03 selected / EP04 and compact tiny thumbnail segments. Below that, a clean two-column working footer: left wide '接着完成这一集' with three actual next-action rows '镜头07 · 调整镜头运动', '对白 · 6条待审核', '成片 · 打开剪辑'; right narrow embedded task rail with '正在进行' and 2 progress jobs, each named current project. Keep whitespace purposeful, coherent radius 18-24 for stage, capsule controls, solid red primary pill, neutral fine separators. Youthful cultured cinema-club collectible identity, not SaaS admin, not kids game. Respect reasonable information density and readable controls.
